title: Gary Nolan presents his injury research the night before the site visit

tellings.quote: I was actually at the the New Mexico site and we hadn't gone there yet it was the night before and we were all just hanging out having a beer and Gary decided he was going to share his research with us and photos

plain: In 2016, on the night before a group visited a site in New Mexico, a scientist named Garry Nolan showed the others his research and photos on injuries, while everyone sat around having a beer. The religion scholar Diana Pasulka tells this as one of the people present, saying "Gary decided he was going to share his research with us and photos." She raises it because it shows serious researchers quietly sharing material of this kind among themselves.
